Hi Willie,

Thanks for writing, and I'm sorry something's changed since you ordered.

Here's where Shop···· stands right now. It's paid, and your Hammer Miner DC08 is already reserved and picked at our Chattanooga warehouse, so it's in the packing queue to go out in the next day or two. I've put a hold on the order on our side, and a colleague is working on stopping the box at the warehouse today before a label prints.

Before we go further, can I ask what's prompted this? If it's the wait, that part is short. If you'd rather have a different machine, I can swap the DC08 for another unit we have on the shelf, same order, and I'll tell you to the cent if anything is owed either way. If it's simply not the right time, I can keep the full $602.25 on your HeliumDeploy account as store credit instead, which applies automatically at checkout whenever you're ready and doesn't expire.

Just reply here and tell me which of those suits you, or what's going on, and I'll sort it from my side. If you'd still rather not keep the order at all after that, say so plainly and I'll take the request to a supervisor for review.

Thanks for your patience, Willie.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

I just decided that I had too many solo miners here at home plus my wife didn’t like it so if you would just cancel the entire order, thank you Sarah S. from [Proton Mail](https://proton.me/mail/home) for iOS.

Hi Willie,

That makes sense, and thank you for telling me straight. No argument from me on the household vote.

Before I take it further, two things, and then it's your call.

Your money doesn't have to leave the house as a cancellation. I can hold the full $602.25 as store credit on your HeliumDeploy account instead. It doesn't expire, it applies by itself at checkout, and it isn't limited to miners, so it covers anything we sell if you want something quieter down the line. That way nothing is lost if you change your mind in six months.

And if you'd rather keep the DC08, I can ask the team to refund $50 of what you paid back to your original payment and leave the order as it is. That's the one time I can offer that on an order, so I'd rather you heard it than not.

If neither of those does it, I understand. I should be honest that cancelling isn't standard practice here, and your unit is already picked and sitting packed at our Chattanooga warehouse, so the request has to go to a supervisor for review. Reply with the word cancel and I'll put it in front of them, and they'll come back to you directly with their decision. I won't promise you an amount or a date in the meantime, because that's theirs to confirm, not mine.

Sorry to see the order go either way, Willie.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Willie,

Understood, and thank you for being clear. Your cancellation request is now with a supervisor, and one of them is picking it up today. They'll come back to you in this thread with their decision, so there's nothing else you need to send.

One thing I have to be straight with you about. Between my last email and this one, the warehouse printed the label on your DC08, tracking ····. I tried to stop it twice and it was already too far along, so the box is likely to leave Chattanooga. If it does arrive at your door, please don't open it beyond checking it's the right parcel. Leave it sealed, and we'll send you a prepaid return label so it comes straight back to us at no cost to you. That's the normal route once a label exists, and it doesn't change what the supervisor decides.

I won't quote you an amount or a date on the money, because that's the supervisor's to confirm and I'd rather not promise you something I don't control. You'll hear from them directly.

Sorry it didn't work out this time, Willie, and thanks for the straight answers along the way.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
